_comment: Final 256 px cell coordinates, measured on the title-style art (Claude, 2026-10-11) from the packed frames (quantize 48): each hit box is the striking limb's contact end (wrist or ankle to the tips) plus 3 px, the packer's auto pad. Killua is the shortest fighter and most of his strikes stay inside his wide idle stance (front foot x 195), so the auto rule picks his hair (light2, light3, airLight2) or the whole front of the body (light1, heavy, airHeavy); these overrides replace them. Frames not listed keep the auto box, checked on the same art: light4 f3-f4 and airLight3 f2-f3 (the kicking shoe), airLight1 f1-f2 (the knife-hand), specialForward f2-f3 (the thrusting forearm and claw). The boxes follow the drawn limbs, so most sit lower and closer than the SPEC contact zones (tuned for the old ~218 px bodies).
_hands: hand: palm point (256 cell) for shots and beams: the centroid of the drawn hand past the wrist, measured by Claude 2026-10-11 on the title-style art from the packed frames. special f3 is the Narukami bolt's spawn frame (without a hand it spawned from the auto hit box on his head), throw f1 the air Narukami's; beamFire f0 is the beam / beam clash origin.
